14: type durableOperationManager struct {
15: 	repository runcontrol.Repository
16: 	owner      runcontrol.Owner
17: 	mu         sync.Mutex
18: 	owned      map[string]*ownedDurableOperation
19: }
20: 
21: type ownedDurableOperation struct {
22: 	fence        runcontrol.Fence
23: 	cancel       context.CancelFunc
24: 	stop         chan struct{}
25: 	done         chan struct{}
26: 	eventMu      sync.Mutex
27: 	progressKey  string
28: 	progressAt   time.Time
29: 	omitted      uint64
30: 	omittedFirst time.Time
31: 	omittedLast  time.Time
32: }
33: 
34: // durableCLICommand is the synchronous CLI counterpart to the web/TUI
35: // acceptance boundary. It keeps the manager alive for the whole command and
36: // gives product code the cancellation-aware context owned by the durable run.
37: type durableCLICommand struct {
38: 	manager  *durableOperationManager
39: 	accepted AcceptedOperation
40: }
41: 
42: type durableOperationContextKey struct{}
43: 
44: type durableOperationOwnership struct {
45: 	repository runcontrol.Repository
46: 	fence      runcontrol.Fence
47: }
48: 
49: func beginDurableCLICommand(deps dependencies, request OperationRequest) (*durableCLICommand, error) {
50: 	repository, _, err := runRepository(deps)
51: 	if err != nil {
52: 		return nil, err
53: 	}
54: 	manager := newDurableOperationManager(repository, deps.runControl.owner)
55: 	accepted, err := manager.AcceptOperation(deps.ctx, Confirmation{Request: request}, "")
56: 	if err != nil {
57: 		return nil, classifiedCause(ExitRuntime, err, "run-control.accept")
58: 	}
59: 	return &durableCLICommand{manager: manager, accepted: accepted}, nil
60: }
61: 
62: func (c *durableCLICommand) Context() context.Context { return c.accepted.Context }
63: 
64: func (c *durableCLICommand) QAWriterToken() (sprint.QAWriterToken, func(sprint.QAWriterToken) error, error) {
65: 	if c == nil {
66: 		return sprint.QAWriterToken{}, nil, errors.New("durable QA ownership is unavailable")
67: 	}
68: 	return qaOwnershipFromContext(c.accepted.Context)
69: }
70: 
71: func (c *durableCLICommand) Finish(runErr error) error {
72: 	state := OperationComplete
73: 	if c.accepted.Context.Err() != nil {
74: 		state = OperationCancelled
75: 	} else if runErr != nil {
76: 		state = OperationFailed
77: 	}
78: 	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 30*time.Second)
79: 	defer cancel()
80: 	if err := c.manager.FinishOperation(ctx, c.accepted.RunID, state, runErr); err != nil {
81: 		return classifiedCause(ExitRuntime, err, "run-control.finish")
82: 	}
83: 	return nil
84: }
85: 
86: func finishDurableCLICommand(command *durableCLICommand, runErr error) error {
87: 	if command == nil {
88: 		return runErr
89: 	}
90: 	return errors.Join(runErr, command.Finish(runErr))
91: }
92: 
93: func newDurableOperationManager(repository runcontrol.Repository, owner runcontrol.Owner) *durableOperationManager {
94: 	return &durableOperationManager{repository: repository, owner: owner, owned: make(map[string]*ownedDurableOperation)}
95: }
96: 
97: func (m *durableOperationManager) AcceptOperation(ctx context.Context, confirmation Confirmation, digest string) (AcceptedOperation, error) {
98: 	req := confirmation.Request
99: 	target := runcontrol.Target{
100: 		Kind: "operation", Operation: string(req.Kind), Project: req.Project, Sprint: req.Sprint,
101: 		Study: req.Study, Stage: req.Stage, Task: req.Task,
102: 	}
103: 	snapshot, err := m.repository.Accept(ctx, runcontrol.Acceptance{
104: 		Target: target, ProductStatus: "prepared", OperationAlias: digest, ConfirmationDigest: digest,
105: 	})
106: 	if err != nil && digest != "" && errors.Is(err, runcontrol.ErrConflict) {
107: 		existing, resolveErr := m.repository.ResolveOperationAlias(ctx, digest)
108: 		if resolveErr != nil {
109: 			return AcceptedOperation{}, errors.Join(err, resolveErr)
110: 		}
111: 		return AcceptedOperation{RunID: string(existing.RunID), Context: ctx, Existing: true, Lifecycle: string(existing.Lifecycle)}, nil
112: 	}
113: 	if err != nil {
114: 		return AcceptedOperation{}, fmt.Errorf("persist confirmed operation acceptance: %w", err)
115: 	}
116: 	attempt, _, err := m.repository.Claim(ctx, runcontrol.Claim{RunID: snapshot.RunID, Owner: m.owner, Lease: runcontrol.OwnerLeaseDuration})
117: 	if err != nil {
118: 		return AcceptedOperation{}, fmt.Errorf("persist confirmed operation owner claim: %w", err)
119: 	}
120: 	fence := runcontrol.Fence{RunID: snapshot.RunID, AttemptID: attempt.ID, OwnerID: m.owner.ID, FencingGeneration: attempt.FencingGeneration}
121: 	if _, _, err := appendRunEventWithRetry(ctx, m.repository, fence, runcontrol.EventDraft{
122: 		Type: runcontrol.EventLifecycle, Lifecycle: runcontrol.LifecycleRunning,
123: 		Payload: map[string]string{"lifecycle": string(runcontrol.LifecycleRunning)},
124: 	}); err != nil {
125: 		terminalCtx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 30*time.Second)
126: 		_, _, _ = proposeRunTerminalWithRetry(terminalCtx, m.repository, fence, runcontrol.TerminalProposal{Outcome: runcontrol.TerminalPersistenceLost, Reason: "operation start persistence failed", ProposedBy: m.owner.ID})
127: 		cancel()
128: 		return AcceptedOperation{}, fmt.Errorf("persist confirmed operation start: %w", err)
129: 	}
130: 	operationCtx, cancel := context.WithCancel(runcontrol.WithParentRun(ctx, snapshot.RunID))
131: 	operationCtx = context.WithValue(operationCtx, durableOperationContextKey{}, durableOperationOwnership{repository: m.repository, fence: fence})
132: 	owned := &ownedDurableOperation{fence: fence, cancel: cancel, stop: make(chan struct{}), done: make(chan struct{})}
133: 	m.mu.Lock()
134: 	m.owned[string(snapshot.RunID)] = owned
135: 	m.mu.Unlock()
136: 	go m.controlOperation(operationCtx, owned)
137: 	return AcceptedOperation{RunID: string(snapshot.RunID), Context: operationCtx, Lifecycle: string(runcontrol.LifecycleRunning)}, nil
138: }
139: 
140: func qaOwnershipFromContext(ctx context.Context) (sprint.QAWriterToken, func(sprint.QAWriterToken) error, error) {
141: 	ownership, ok := ctx.Value(durableOperationContextKey{}).(durableOperationOwnership)
142: 	if !ok || ownership.repository == nil {
143: 		return sprint.QAWriterToken{}, nil, errors.New("durable QA ownership is missing from the operation context")
144: 	}
145: 	token := sprint.QAWriterToken{RunID: string(ownership.fence.RunID), OperationalAttemptID: string(ownership.fence.AttemptID), FencingGeneration: ownership.fence.FencingGeneration}
146: 	fence := func(got sprint.QAWriterToken) error {
147: 		if got != token {
148: 			return runcontrol.ErrStaleFence
149: 		}
150: 		fenceCtx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.WithoutCancel(ctx), 30*time.Second)
151: 		defer cancel()
152: 		_, err := ownership.repository.Heartbeat(fenceCtx, ownership.fence, runControlLease)
153: 		return err
154: 	}
155: 	return token, fence, nil
156: }
157: 
158: func (m *durableOperationManager) RecordOperationEvent(ctx context.Context, runID string, event OperationEvent) (bool, error) {
159: 	m.mu.Lock()
160: 	owned := m.owned[runID]
161: 	m.mu.Unlock()
162: 	if owned == nil {
163: 		return false, runcontrol.ErrNotFound
164: 	}
165: 	owned.eventMu.Lock()
166: 	defer owned.eventMu.Unlock()
167: 	eventType := runcontrol.EventProgress
168: 	if event.State == OperationFailed {
169: 		eventType = runcontrol.EventWarning
170: 	}
171: 	key := string(eventType) + "\x00" + event.Stage + "\x00" + event.Task + "\x00" + event.PhaseState + "\x00" + event.SafeSummary + "\x00" + event.EventType + "\x00" + event.EventKind + "\x00" + event.Tool + "\x00" + event.Reason + "\x00" + event.Detail
172: 	now := time.Now().UTC()
173: 	elapsed := now.Sub(owned.progressAt)
174: 	if eventType == runcontrol.EventProgress && key == owned.progressKey && elapsed >= 0 && elapsed < runcontrol.ProgressCoalesceWindow {
175: 		if owned.omitted == 0 {
176: 			owned.omittedFirst = now
177: 		}
178: 		owned.omitted++
179: 		owned.omittedLast = now
180: 		return false, nil
181: 	}
182: 	payload := map[string]string{
183: 		"state": string(event.State), "type": event.EventType,
184: 		"count": fmt.Sprintf("%d/%d", event.Completed, event.Total),
185: 	}
186: 	for key, value := range map[string]string{
187: 		"phase_state": event.PhaseState, "summary": event.SafeSummary,
188: 		"tool_call_id": event.ToolCallID, "tool_status": event.ToolStatus,
189: 		"tool_arguments": event.ToolArguments, "tool_result": event.ToolResult, "tool_error": event.ToolError,
190: 		"provider": event.Provider, "model": event.Model, "harness": event.Harness,
191: 	} {
192: 		if value != "" {
193: 			payload[key] = value
194: 		}
195: 	}
196: 	var omission *runcontrol.Omission
197: 	if event.Message != "" {
198: 		omission = &runcontrol.Omission{Reason: "presentation message omitted", Count: 1}
199: 	}
200: 	if owned.omitted > 0 {
201: 		if omission == nil {
202: 			omission = &runcontrol.Omission{Reason: "equivalent progress coalesced"}
203: 		}
204: 		omission.Count += owned.omitted
205: 		omission.FirstAt, omission.LastAt = &owned.omittedFirst, &owned.omittedLast
206: 		owned.omitted = 0
207: 	}
208: 	_, _, err := appendRunEventWithRetry(ctx, m.repository, owned.fence, runcontrol.EventDraft{
209: 		Type: eventType, Scope: runcontrol.EventScopeOperation, Stage: event.Stage, Task: event.Task,
210: 		Kind: event.EventKind, Tool: event.Tool, Action: event.Action, Reason: event.Reason,
211: 		Detail: event.Detail, Payload: payload, Omission: omission,
212: 	})
213: 	if err != nil {
214: 		owned.cancel()
215: 		return false, err
216: 	}
217: 	if eventType == runcontrol.EventProgress {
218: 		owned.progressKey, owned.progressAt = key, now
219: 	}
220: 	return true, nil
221: }
222: 
223: func (m *durableOperationManager) controlOperation(ctx context.Context, owned *ownedDurableOperation) {
224: 	defer close(owned.done)
225: 	ticker := time.NewTicker(runcontrol.OwnerTickInterval)
226: 	defer ticker.Stop()
227: 	lastHeartbeat, lastReconcile := time.Now(), time.Now()
228: 	for {
229: 		select {
230: 		case <-ctx.Done():
231: 			return
232: 		case <-owned.stop:
233: 			return
234: 		case now := <-ticker.C:
235: 			snapshot, err := m.repository.Snapshot(ctx, owned.fence.RunID)
236: 			if err != nil {
237: 				owned.cancel()
238: 				return
239: 			}
240: 			if snapshot.Cancellation.State == runcontrol.CancellationRequested {
241: 				if _, _, err := m.repository.AcknowledgeCancellation(ctx, owned.fence); err != nil {
242: 					owned.cancel()
243: 					return
244: 				}
245: 				owned.cancel()

154: 	full, _ := time.ParseDuration(c.RunControl.FullHistory)
155: 	tombstone, _ := time.ParseDuration(c.RunControl.TombstoneHistory)
156: 	return runcontrol.RetentionPolicy{FullHistory: full, TombstoneHistory: tombstone, HardQuotaBytes: c.RunControl.WorkspaceQuota}
157: }

159: func (r controlledRuntime) StartRun(ctx context.Context, req runtimepkg.Request) (runtimepkg.Result, error) {
160: 	target := targetFromRuntimeRequest(req)
161: 	correlation := runcontrol.Correlation{
162: 		ProductRunID:  boundedSafe(string(runcontrol.ParentRun(ctx))),
163: 		ProductTaskID: boundedSafe(req.TraceID),
164: 	}
165: 	snapshot, err := r.repository.Accept(ctx, runcontrol.Acceptance{
166: 		Target:        target,
167: 		Correlation:   correlation,
168: 		ProductStatus: "accepted",
169: 	})
170: 	if err != nil {
171: 		return runtimepkg.Result{}, fmt.Errorf("durable run acceptance failed: %w", err)
172: 	}
173: 	attempt, _, err := r.repository.Claim(ctx, runcontrol.Claim{
174: 		RunID: snapshot.RunID, Owner: r.owner, Lease: runControlLease, Correlation: correlation,
175: 	})
176: 	if err != nil {
177: 		return runtimepkg.Result{}, fmt.Errorf("durable run ownership failed: %w", err)
178: 	}
179: 	fence := runcontrol.Fence{
180: 		RunID: snapshot.RunID, AttemptID: attempt.ID, OwnerID: r.owner.ID,
181: 		FencingGeneration: attempt.FencingGeneration,
182: 	}
183: 
184: 	runCtx, cancel := context.WithCancel(ctx)
185: 	defer cancel()
186: 	req.Metadata = cloneRuntimeMetadata(req.Metadata)
187: 	req.Metadata["run_control_run_id"] = string(snapshot.RunID)
188: 	configuredOnEvent := req.OnEvent
189: 	var eventMu sync.Mutex
190: 	var persistenceErr error
191: 	var progressKey string
192: 	var progressCommittedAt time.Time
193: 	var progressOmitted uint64
194: 	var progressOmittedFirst time.Time
195: 	var progressOmittedLast time.Time
196: 	setPersistenceErr := func(value error) {
197: 		eventMu.Lock()
198: 		defer eventMu.Unlock()
199: 		if persistenceErr == nil {
200: 			persistenceErr = value
201: 			cancel()
202: 		}
203: 	}
204: 	req.OnEvent = func(event runtimepkg.Event) {
205: 		eventMu.Lock()
206: 		defer eventMu.Unlock()
207: 		if persistenceErr != nil {
208: 			return
209: 		}
210: 		draft := runtimeEventDraft(req, event)
211: 		eventAt := event.Time.UTC()
212: 		if eventAt.IsZero() {
213: 			eventAt = time.Now().UTC()
214: 		}
215: 		// Content-aware coalescing: only collapse identical progress payloads within the window.
216: 		// Reasoning/text deltas and tool calls have distinct payload hashes and will not coalesce.
217: 		hash := payloadHash(draft.Payload)
218: 		key := string(draft.Type) + "\x00" + draft.Stage + "\x00" + draft.Task + "\x00" + hash
219: 		elapsed := eventAt.Sub(progressCommittedAt)
220: 		if draft.Type == runcontrol.EventProgress && key == progressKey && elapsed >= 0 && elapsed < runcontrol.ProgressCoalesceWindow {
221: 			if progressOmitted == 0 {
222: 				progressOmittedFirst = eventAt
223: 			}
224: 			progressOmitted++
225: 			progressOmittedLast = eventAt
226: 			return
227: 		}
228: 		if progressOmitted > 0 {
229: 			if draft.Omission == nil {
230: 				draft.Omission = &runcontrol.Omission{Reason: "equivalent progress coalesced"}
231: 			}
232: 			draft.Omission.Count += progressOmitted
233: 			draft.Omission.FirstAt = &progressOmittedFirst
234: 			draft.Omission.LastAt = &progressOmittedLast
235: 			progressOmitted = 0
236: 		}
237: 		if _, _, appendErr := appendRunEventWithRetry(runCtx, r.repository, fence, draft); appendErr != nil {
238: 			persistenceErr = fmt.Errorf("persist runtime event: %w", appendErr)
239: 			cancel()
240: 			return
241: 		}
242: 		if draft.Type == runcontrol.EventProgress {
243: 			progressKey = key
244: 			progressCommittedAt = eventAt
245: 		}
246: 		if configuredOnEvent != nil {
247: 			configuredOnEvent(event)
248: 		}
249: 	}
250: 
251: 	controlDone := make(chan struct{})
252: 	go func() {
253: 		defer close(controlDone)
254: 		ticker := time.NewTicker(runcontrol.OwnerTickInterval)
255: 		defer ticker.Stop()
256: 		lastHeartbeat := time.Now()
257: 		lastReconcile := time.Now()
258: 		for {
259: 			select {
260: 			case <-runCtx.Done():
261: 				return
262: 			case now := <-ticker.C:
263: 				snapshot, err := r.repository.Snapshot(runCtx, fence.RunID)
264: 				if err != nil {
265: 					if runCtx.Err() != nil {
266: 						return
267: 					}
268: 					setPersistenceErr(fmt.Errorf("poll durable run control: %w", err))
269: 					return
270: 				}
271: 				if snapshot.Cancellation.State == runcontrol.CancellationRequested {
272: 					if _, _, err := r.repository.AcknowledgeCancellation(runCtx, fence); err != nil {
273: 						setPersistenceErr(fmt.Errorf("acknowledge durable cancellation: %w", err))
274: 						return
275: 					}
276: 					cancel()
277: 					return
278: 				}
279: 				if now.Sub(lastHeartbeat) >= runcontrol.HeartbeatInterval {
280: 					if _, err := r.repository.Heartbeat(runCtx, fence, runControlLease); err != nil {
281: 						if runCtx.Err() != nil {
282: 							return
283: 						}
284: 						setPersistenceErr(fmt.Errorf("persist owner heartbeat: %w", err))
285: 						return
286: 					}
287: 					lastHeartbeat = now
288: 				}
289: 				if now.Sub(lastReconcile) >= runcontrol.ReconciliationInterval {
290: 					if _, err := r.repository.Reconcile(runCtx, runcontrol.NativeProcessProbe{}, runcontrol.ReconcileOptions{}); err != nil {
291: 						if runCtx.Err() != nil {
292: 							return
293: 						}
294: 						setPersistenceErr(fmt.Errorf("reconcile durable runs: %w", err))
295: 						return
296: 					}
297: 					lastReconcile = now
298: 				}
299: 			}
300: 		}
301: 	}()
302: 	result, runErr := r.base.StartRun(runCtx, req)
303: 	eventMu.Lock()
304: 	if persistenceErr == nil && progressOmitted > 0 {
305: 		_, _, appendErr := appendRunEventWithRetry(runCtx, r.repository, fence, runcontrol.EventDraft{
306: 			Type: runcontrol.EventOmission,
307: 			Omission: &runcontrol.Omission{
308: 				Reason: "equivalent progress coalesced", Count: progressOmitted,
309: 				FirstAt: &progressOmittedFirst, LastAt: &progressOmittedLast,
310: 			},
311: 		})
312: 		if appendErr != nil {
313: 			persistenceErr = fmt.Errorf("persist progress omission: %w", appendErr)
314: 		}
315: 	}
316: 	eventMu.Unlock()
317: 	cancel()
318: 	<-controlDone
319: 	eventMu.Lock()
320: 	persistErr := persistenceErr
321: 	eventMu.Unlock()
322: 	if persistErr != nil {
323: 		terminalCtx, terminalCancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 30*time.Second)
324: 		_, _, terminalErr := proposeRunTerminalWithRetry(terminalCtx, r.repository, fence, runcontrol.TerminalProposal{
325: 			Outcome: runcontrol.TerminalPersistenceLost, Reason: "durable event persistence failed", ProposedBy: r.owner.ID,
326: 		})
327: 		terminalCancel()
328: 		if terminalErr != nil {
329: 			return result, errors.Join(persistErr, terminalErr)
330: 		}
331: 		return result, persistErr
332: 	}
333: 
334: 	outcome, reason := terminalOutcome(result, runErr, ctx)
335: 	terminalCtx, terminalCancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 30*time.Second)
336: 	defer terminalCancel()
337: 	if _, _, err := proposeRunTerminalWithRetry(terminalCtx, r.repository, fence, runcontrol.TerminalProposal{
338: 		Outcome: outcome, Reason: reason, ProposedBy: r.owner.ID,
339: 	}); err != nil {
340: 		return result, errors.Join(runErr, fmt.Errorf("persist terminal run outcome: %w", err))
341: 	}
342: 	return result, runErr
343: }
344: 
345: func appendRunEventWithRetry(ctx context.Context, repository runcontrol.Repository, fence runcontrol.Fence, draft runcontrol.EventDraft) (runcontrol.Event, runcontrol.Snapshot, error) {
346: 	deadline := time.Now().Add(5 * time.Second)
347: 	for {
348: 		event, snapshot, err := repository.Append(ctx, fence, draft)
349: 		if err == nil || !retryableRunControlError(err) || !time.Now().Before(deadline) {
350: 			return event, snapshot, err
351: 		}
352: 		if err := waitRunControlRetry(ctx, deadline); err != nil {
353: 			return runcontrol.Event{}, runcontrol.Snapshot{}, err
354: 		}
355: 	}
356: }
357: 
358: func proposeRunTerminalWithRetry(ctx context.Context, repository runcontrol.Repository, fence runcontrol.Fence, proposal runcontrol.TerminalProposal) (runcontrol.Snapshot, bool, error) {
359: 	for {
360: 		snapshot, won, err := repository.ProposeTerminal(ctx, fence, proposal)
361: 		if err == nil || !retryableRunControlError(err) {
362: 			return snapshot, won, err
363: 		}
364: 		if err := waitRunControlRetry(ctx, time.Now().Add(250*time.Millisecond)); err != nil {
365: 			return runcontrol.Snapshot{}, false, err
366: 		}
367: 	}
368: }
369: 
370: func retryableRunControlError(err error) bool {
371: 	return errors.Is(err, runcontrol.ErrUnavailable) || errors.Is(err, runcontrol.ErrBusy)
372: }
373: 
374: func waitRunControlRetry(ctx context.Context, deadline time.Time) error {
375: 	wait := time.Until(deadline)
376: 	if wait > 100*time.Millisecond {
377: 		wait = 100 * time.Millisecond
378: 	}
379: 	if wait <= 0 {
380: 		return context.DeadlineExceeded
381: 	}
382: 	timer := time.NewTimer(wait)
383: 	defer timer.Stop()
384: 	select {
385: 	case <-ctx.Done():
386: 		return ctx.Err()
387: 	case <-timer.C:
388: 		return nil
389: 	}
390: }

392: func targetFromRuntimeRequest(req runtimepkg.Request) runcontrol.Target {
393: 	target := runcontrol.Target{
394: 		Kind:      boundedSafe(req.PromptRef.OwnerKind),
395: 		Operation: boundedSafe(req.PromptRef.Purpose),
396: 		Project:   boundedSafe(req.Metadata["project"]),
397: 		Sprint:    boundedSafe(req.Metadata["sprint"]),
398: 		Study:     boundedSafe(req.Metadata["study"]),
399: 		Stage:     boundedSafe(req.Metadata["stage"]),
400: 		Task:      boundedSafe(firstSafeValue(req.Metadata["task"], req.Metadata["task.kind"], req.Metadata["coverage"])),
401: 	}
402: 	if target.Kind == "" {
403: 		if target.Study != "" {
404: 			target.Kind = "study"
405: 		} else if target.Sprint != "" {
406: 			target.Kind = "sprint"
407: 		} else {
408: 			target.Kind = "runtime"
409: 		}
410: 	}
411: 	if target.Operation == "" {
412: 		target.Operation = boundedSafe(firstSafeValue(target.Stage, req.Metadata["task.kind"], req.PromptRef.ID, "runtime"))
413: 	}
414: 	return target
415: }

417: func runtimeEventDraft(req runtimepkg.Request, event runtimepkg.Event) runcontrol.EventDraft {
418: 	eventType := runcontrol.EventProgress
419: 	lowerType := strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(event.Type))
420: 	lowerKind := strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(event.Kind))
421: 	switch lowerType {
422: 	case "warning", "warn", "error":
423: 		eventType = runcontrol.EventWarning
424: 	case "artifact", "file":
425: 		eventType = runcontrol.EventArtifact
426: 	case "finding":
427: 		eventType = runcontrol.EventFinding
428: 	case "message", "text", "output", "assistant_text", "reasoning_text", "reasoning", "content", "delta":
429: 		eventType = runcontrol.EventMessage
430: 	default:
431: 		// Kind-based fallback: reasoning and message kinds should be visible as message, not coalesced progress.
432: 		switch lowerKind {
433: 		case "message", "reasoning", "assistant", "assistant_text", "reasoning_text":
434: 			eventType = runcontrol.EventMessage
435: 		case "tool", "tool_use", "tool_call", "tool_call_update":
436: 			// Tools stay as progress but with distinct payload so coalescing can distinguish.
437: 			eventType = runcontrol.EventProgress
438: 		}
439: 	}
440: 	payload := map[string]string{
441: 		"runtime_event_id": boundedSafe(event.ID),
442: 		"runtime_run_id":   boundedSafe(event.RunID),
443: 		"session_id":       boundedSafe(event.SessionID),
444: 		"type":             boundedSafe(event.Type),
445: 		"kind":             boundedSafe(event.Kind),
446: 	}
447: 	if lowerKind == "tool" || lowerKind == "tool_use" || lowerKind == "tool_call" || lowerKind == "tool_call_update" {
448: 		captureToolObservation(payload, event.Payload)
449: 	}
450: 	// Preserve safe observable payload fields into durable storage for observability.
451: 	// Deny sensitive keys and truncate values to runcontrol-safe limits.
452: 	// Flatten one level of nesting so tool/action names buried in maps are surfaced as top-level payload keys
453: 	// that the run timeline JS expects (payload.tool, payload.action, payload.title, etc.).
454: 	for key, value := range event.Payload {
455: 		if isSensitivePayloadKey(key) {
456: 			continue
457: 		}
458: 		normalized := strings.TrimSpace(key)
459: 		if normalized == "" || len(normalized) > 128 || strings.ContainsAny(normalized, "\x00\r\n") {
460: 			continue
461: 		}
462: 		if normalized == "type" || normalized == "kind" {
463: 			continue
464: 		}
465: 		if nested, ok := value.(map[string]any); ok {
466: 			for subKey, subVal := range nested {
467: 				if isSensitivePayloadKey(subKey) {
468: 					continue
469: 				}
470: 				subNorm := strings.TrimSpace(subKey)
471: 				if subNorm == "" || len(subNorm) > 128 || strings.ContainsAny(subNorm, "\x00\r\n") {
472: 					continue
473: 				}
474: 				if _, exists := payload[subNorm]; exists {
475: 					continue
476: 				}
477: 				// Promote common observable sub-keys; namespace the rest to avoid collisions.
478: 				promote := map[string]bool{"tool": true, "title": true, "detail": true, "text": true, "delta": true, "content": true, "message": true, "action": true, "state": true, "status": true, "native_type": true, "line": true}
479: 				targetKey := subNorm
480: 				if !promote[subNorm] {
481: 					targetKey = normalized + "_" + subNorm
482: 					if len(targetKey) > 128 {
483: 						continue
484: 					}
485: 				}
486: 				if _, exists := payload[targetKey]; exists {
487: 					continue
488: 				}
489: 				str := payloadValueString(subVal)
490: 				if strings.TrimSpace(str) == "" {
491: 					continue
492: 				}
493: 				if len(payload) >= 30 {
494: 					break
495: 				}
496: 				payload[targetKey] = boundedPayloadValue(str)
497: 			}
498: 			// Also keep a compact stringified top-level for debugging if not promoted.
499: 			if len(payload) < 30 {
500: 				if _, exists := payload[normalized]; !exists {
501: 					str := payloadValueString(value)
502: 					if strings.TrimSpace(str) != "" && !strings.HasPrefix(str, "[map omitted") {
503: 						payload[normalized] = boundedPayloadValue(str)
504: 					}
505: 				}
506: 			}
507: 			continue
508: 		}
509: 		str := payloadValueString(value)
510: 		if strings.TrimSpace(str) == "" {
511: 			continue
512: 		}
513: 		if len(payload) >= 30 {
514: 			break
515: 		}
516: 		if _, exists := payload[normalized]; exists {
517: 			continue
518: 		}
519: 		payload[normalized] = boundedPayloadValue(str)
520: 	}
521: 	// Ensure the most useful display keys are always present even if nested.
522: 	for _, want := range []string{"tool", "action", "title", "detail", "text", "delta"} {
523: 		if _, ok := payload[want]; ok {
524: 			continue
525: 		}
526: 		if v := findNestedString(event.Payload, want); v != "" {
527: 			payload[want] = boundedPayloadValue(v)
528: 		}
529: 	}
530: 	omission := (*runcontrol.Omission)(nil)
531: 	if event.RawPresent || event.RawOmitted {
532: 		reason := firstSafeValue(event.RawOmissionReason, "runtime payload omitted by safe persistence policy")
533: 		omission = &runcontrol.Omission{Reason: boundedSafe(reason), Count: 1}
534: 	} else if len(event.Payload) > len(payload)-5 {
535: 		// Payload had more fields than we persisted (truncated/omitted keys) – record for diagnostics but don't hide persisted fields.
536: 		omission = &runcontrol.Omission{Reason: boundedSafe("runtime payload truncated to safe observable fields"), Count: 1}
537: 	}
538: 	return runcontrol.EventDraft{
539: 		Type: eventType, Scope: runcontrol.EventScopeRuntime,
540: 		Stage: boundedSafe(req.Metadata["stage"]), Task: boundedSafe(firstSafeValue(req.Metadata["task"], req.Metadata["task.kind"])),
541: 		Kind: payload["kind"], Tool: payload["tool"], Action: payload["action"],
542: 		Reason: payload["reason"], Detail: firstSafeValue(payload["detail"], payload["title"]),
543: 		Payload: payload, Omission: omission,
544: 	}
545: }
546: 
547: func isSensitivePayloadKey(key string) bool {
548: 	lower := strings.ToLower(key)
549: 	for _, marker := range []string{"secret", "token", "password", "authorization", "cookie", "api_key", "apikey", "credential", "auth"} {
550: 		if strings.Contains(lower, marker) {
551: 			return true
552: 		}
553: 	}
554: 	return false
555: }
556: 
557: func findNestedString(payload map[string]any, want string) string {
558: 	for _, v := range payload {
559: 		if m, ok := v.(map[string]any); ok {
560: 			if s, ok := m[want].(string); ok && strings.TrimSpace(s) != "" {
561: 				return s
562: 			}
563: 			// One more level deep (common for opencode part.state structures)
564: 			for _, inner := range m {
565: 				if innerMap, ok := inner.(map[string]any); ok {
566: 					if s, ok := innerMap[want].(string); ok && strings.TrimSpace(s) != "" {
567: 						return s
568: 					}
569: 				}
570: 			}
571: 		}
572: 	}
573: 	return ""
574: }
575: 
576: func payloadValueString(value any) string {
577: 	switch v := value.(type) {
578: 	case string:
579: 		return v
580: 	case []byte:
581: 		if len(v) == 0 {
582: 			return ""
583: 		}
584: 		return string(v)
585: 	case bool:
586: 		if v {
587: 			return "true"
588: 		}
589: 		return "false"
590: 	case int:
591: 		return fmt.Sprintf("%d", v)
592: 	case int8:
593: 		return fmt.Sprintf("%d", v)
594: 	case int16:
595: 		return fmt.Sprintf("%d", v)
596: 	case int32:
597: 		return fmt.Sprintf("%d", v)
598: 	case int64:
599: 		return fmt.Sprintf("%d", v)
600: 	case uint, uint8, uint16, uint32, uint64:
601: 		return fmt.Sprintf("%d", v)
602: 	case float32, float64:
603: 		return fmt.Sprintf("%v", v)
604: 	case map[string]any, map[string]string, []any, []string:
605: 		// Encode structured values compactly.
606: 		encoded, err := jsonMarshalTruncated(v)
607: 		if err != nil {
608: 			return fmt.Sprintf("%v", v)
609: 		}
610: 		return encoded
611: 	default:
612: 		return fmt.Sprintf("%v", v)
613: 	}
614: }
615: 
616: func jsonMarshalTruncated(v any) (string, error) {
617: 	encoded, err := json.Marshal(v)
618: 	if err != nil {
619: 		return "", err
620: 	}
621: 	return string(encoded), nil
622: }
623: 
624: func captureToolObservation(out map[string]string, payload map[string]any) {
625: 	for target, aliases := range map[string][]string{
626: 		"tool_call_id": {"tool_call_id", "toolCallId", "call_id", "callID"},
627: 		"tool_name":    {"tool_name", "toolName", "tool", "name"},
628: 		"tool_status":  {"tool_status", "status", "phase"},
629: 	} {
630: 		if value := findNestedPayloadValue(payload, aliases, 0); value != nil {
631: 			if text, ok := value.(string); ok && strings.TrimSpace(text) != "" {
632: 				out[target] = boundedPayloadValue(text)
633: 			}
634: 		}
635: 	}
636: 	for target, aliases := range map[string][]string{
637: 		"tool_arguments": {"tool_arguments", "arguments", "args", "input", "parameters"},
638: 		"tool_result":    {"tool_result", "result", "output", "content"},
639: 		"tool_error":     {"tool_error", "error"},
640: 	} {
641: 		value := findNestedPayloadValue(payload, aliases, 0)
642: 		if value == nil {
643: 			continue
644: 		}
645: 		encoded, err := json.Marshal(redactObservableValue(value))
646: 		if err == nil && string(encoded) != "null" {
647: 			out[target] = boundedPayloadValue(string(encoded))
648: 		}
649: 	}
650: 	if out["tool"] == "" {
651: 		out["tool"] = out["tool_name"]
652: 	}
653: }
654: 
655: func findNestedPayloadValue(value any, aliases []string, depth int) any {
656: 	if depth > 5 {
657: 		return nil
658: 	}
659: 	switch typed := value.(type) {
660: 	case map[string]any:
661: 		for _, key := range aliases {
662: 			if found, ok := typed[key]; ok && found != nil {
663: 				return found
664: 			}
665: 		}
666: 		keys := make([]string, 0, len(typed))
667: 		for key := range typed {
668: 			keys = append(keys, key)
669: 		}
670: 		sort.Strings(keys)
671: 		for _, key := range keys {
672: 			if found := findNestedPayloadValue(typed[key], aliases, depth+1); found != nil {
673: 				return found
674: 			}
675: 		}
676: 	case []any:
677: 		for _, item := range typed {
678: 			if found := findNestedPayloadValue(item, aliases, depth+1); found != nil {
679: 				return found
680: 			}
681: 		}
682: 	}
683: 	return nil
684: }
685: 
686: func redactObservableValue(value any) any {
687: 	switch typed := value.(type) {
688: 	case map[string]any:
689: 		redacted := make(map[string]any, len(typed))
690: 		for key, item := range typed {
691: 			if isSensitivePayloadKey(key) {
692: 				redacted[key] = "[REDACTED]"
693: 			} else {
694: 				redacted[key] = redactObservableValue(item)
695: 			}
696: 		}
697: 		return redacted
698: 	case []any:
699: 		redacted := make([]any, len(typed))
700: 		for index, item := range typed {
701: 			redacted[index] = redactObservableValue(item)
702: 		}
703: 		return redacted
704: 	case string:
705: 		lower := strings.ToLower(typed)

376: func (h *operationHub) subscribe(session, id string, lastID uint64) ([]operationEvent, <-chan operationEvent, func(), error) {

410: 		h.counters.activeStreams.Add(1)
411: 	}

331: 	if err := r.ParseForm(); err != nil || r.FormValue("_csrf") != csrfToken(r.Context()) {
332: 		h.renderError(w, r, http.StatusForbidden, "Request rejected", "The browser session or CSRF proof is invalid. Refresh and prepare again.")
333: 		return
334: 	}
335: 	if h.hub == nil || h.hub.ops == nil {
336: 		h.renderError(w, r, http.StatusServiceUnavailable, "Unavailable", "The operation capability is unavailable.")
337: 		return
338: 	}
339: 	spec := operationSpecFromForm(r)
340: 	req, err := mapOperationRequest(spec)
341: 	if err != nil {
342: 		h.renderError(w, r, http.StatusBadRequest, "Invalid operation", "The selected operation scope is invalid.")
343: 		return
344: 	}
345: 	current, err := h.hub.ops.PrepareOperation(r.Context(), req)
346: 	if err != nil {
347: 		h.renderError(w, r, http.StatusUnprocessableEntity, "Preparation stale", htmlOperationFailure("The operation can no longer be prepared. Return to the owning page and prepare again.", err))
348: 		return
349: 	}
350: 	token := r.FormValue("confirmation_token")
351: 	doc, err := h.hub.startConfirmed(sessionID(r.Context()), confirmationDedupKey(sessionID(r.Context()), token), func() (app.Confirmation, error) {
352: 		return h.preparations.consume(token, sessionID(r.Context()), current.CanonicalRequest, current.InputFingerprint)
353: 	})
354: 	if err != nil {
355: 		h.renderError(w, r, http.StatusConflict, "Confirmation rejected", "The confirmation expired, changed, or was already used. Prepare the operation again.")
356: 		return
357: 	}
358: 	h.logOperation(r, "operation_started", doc.ID, string(doc.Kind), doc.State, "")
359: 	http.Redirect(w, r, "/operations/"+doc.ID, http.StatusSeeOther)
360: }

382: 	if err := r.ParseForm(); err != nil || r.FormValue("_csrf") != csrfToken(r.Context()) {
383: 		h.renderError(w, r, http.StatusForbidden, "Request rejected", "The browser session or CSRF proof is invalid. Refresh the operation page and try again.")
384: 		return
385: 	}
386: 	if h.hub == nil {
387: 		h.renderError(w, r, http.StatusServiceUnavailable, "Unavailable", "The operation capability is unavailable.")
388: 		return
389: 	}
390: 	doc, requested, err := h.hub.cancelOperation(sessionID(r.Context()), id, "user_request")
391: 	if err != nil && h.runs != nil {
392: 		snapshot, changed, cancelErr := h.runs.CancelRun(r.Context(), app.RunID(id), "user_requested")

394: 			doc, requested, err = durableOperationDocument(snapshot), changed, nil

397: 	if err != nil {
398: 		if legacyOperationID(id) {
399: 			h.renderError(w, r, http.StatusGone, "Legacy operation not retained", "This pre-durable operation expired. Refresh the owning product or open the workspace run list.")

401: 		}
402: 		h.renderError(w, r, http.StatusNotFound, "Operation not retained", "Refresh the owning project, sprint, or study page for durable status.")
403: 		return
404: 	}
405: 	if requested {
406: 		h.logOperation(r, "operation_cancel_requested", doc.ID, string(doc.Kind), doc.State, doc.Reason)
407: 	}
408: 	http.Redirect(w, r, "/operations/"+doc.ID, http.StatusSeeOther)
409: }

444: // followDurableOperationEvents is the compatibility projection for a run that
445: // was accepted by this or another local server but is absent from this
446: // process's transient operation hub.
447: func (h *handler) followDurableOperationEvents(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request, id string, after uint64) bool {
448: 	if h.runs == nil {
449: 		return false
450: 	}
451: 	snapshot, err := h.runs.Run(r.Context(), app.RunID(id))
452: 	if err != nil || string(snapshot.RunID) != id || snapshot.Target.Kind != "operation" {
453: 		return false
454: 	}
455: 	if after > snapshot.LastSequence {
456: 		h.writeError(w, r, http.StatusConflict, "cursor_ahead", "The event cursor is ahead of the durable operation.")
457: 		return true
458: 	}
459: 	if after+1 < snapshot.OldestRetainedSequence {
460: 		h.writeError(w, r, http.StatusConflict, "replay_gap", "The requested operation history is no longer retained; refresh its canonical run.")
461: 		return true
462: 	}
463: 	flusher, ok := w.(http.Flusher)
464: 	if !ok {
465: 		h.writeOperationError(w, r, errors.New("streaming unavailable"))
466: 		return true
467: 	}
468: 	w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "text/event-stream; charset=utf-8")
469: 	w.Header().Set("Connection", "keep-alive")
470: 	w.Header().Set("X-Accel-Buffering", "no")
471: 	w.WriteHeader(http.StatusOK)
472: 	flusher.Flush()
473: 	heartbeat := time.NewTicker(SSEHeartbeat)
474: 	defer heartbeat.Stop()
475: 	lifetime := time.NewTimer(MaxStreamLifetime)
476: 	defer lifetime.Stop()
477: 	poll := time.NewTimer(0)
478: 	defer poll.Stop()
479: 	for {
480: 		select {
481: 		case <-poll.C:
482: 			events, eventErr := h.runs.RunEvents(r.Context(), snapshot.RunID, after, 512)
483: 			if eventErr != nil {
484: 				return true
485: 			}
486: 			for _, event := range events {
487: 				projected := durableOperationEvent(event)
488: 				if err := writeSSEEvent(w, projected); err != nil {
489: 					return true
490: 				}
491: 				after = event.Sequence
492: 			}
493: 			flusher.Flush()
494: 			snapshot, eventErr = h.runs.Run(r.Context(), snapshot.RunID)
495: 			if eventErr != nil || snapshot.Lifecycle.IsTerminal() && after >= snapshot.LastSequence {
496: 				return true
497: 			}
498: 			wait := time.Second
499: 			if len(events) == 512 || after < snapshot.LastSequence {
500: 				wait = 250 * time.Millisecond
501: 			}
502: 			poll.Reset(wait)
503: 		case <-heartbeat.C:
504: 			if _, err := io.WriteString(w, ": heartbeat\n\n"); err != nil {
505: 				return true
506: 			}
507: 			flusher.Flush()
508: 		case <-lifetime.C:
509: 			return true
510: 		case <-r.Context().Done():
511: 			return true
512: 		}
513: 	}
514: }

516: func durableOperationEvent(event app.RunEvent) operationEvent {
517: 	name := "progress"
518: 	switch string(event.Type) {
519: 	case "accepted", "claimed", "lifecycle":
520: 		name = "snapshot"
521: 	case "warning", "finding", "artifact", "terminal":
522: 		name = string(event.Type)
523: 	case "cancellation":
524: 		name = "cancel_requested"
525: 	case "recovery", "omission":
526: 		name = "recovery_required"
527: 	}
528: 	payload := map[string]any{"stage": event.Stage, "task": event.Task, "payload": event.Payload, "omission": event.Omission}
529: 	body, _ := json.Marshal(map[string]any{
530: 		"operation_id": string(event.RunID), "time": event.CommittedAt.UTC().Format(time.RFC3339Nano),
531: 		"sequence": event.Sequence, "payload": payload,
532: 	})
533: 	return operationEvent{ID: event.Sequence, Name: name, Data: body}
534: }

555: func newSprintRef(number, name string) string {
556: 	number = strings.TrimSpace(number)
557: 	name = strings.TrimSpace(name)
558: 	if number == "" || name == "" {
559: 		return ""
560: 	}
561: 	for _, r := range number {
562: 		if r < '0' || r > '9' {
563: 			return number + "-" + name
564: 		}
565: 	}
566: 	var slug strings.Builder
567: 	separator := false
568: 	for _, r := range strings.ToLower(name) {
569: 		switch {
570: 		case r >= 'a' && r <= 'z', r >= '0' && r <= '9':
571: 			if separator && slug.Len() > 0 {
572: 				slug.WriteByte('-')
573: 			}
574: 			slug.WriteRune(r)
575: 			separator = false
576: 		case r == ' ' || r == '-' || r == '_':
577: 			separator = true
578: 		default:
579: 			return number + "-" + name
580: 		}
581: 	}
582: 	if slug.Len() == 0 {
583: 		return ""
584: 	}
585: 	return number + "-" + slug.String()
586: }

593: func decodeStrictJSON(r *http.Request, target any) error {
594: 	contentType := r.Header.Get("Content-Type")
595: 	if !strings.HasPrefix(strings.ToLower(contentType), "application/json") {
596: 		return fmt.Errorf("Content-Type must be application/json")
597: 	}
598: 	decoder := json.NewDecoder(r.Body)
599: 	decoder.DisallowUnknownFields()
600: 	if err := decoder.Decode(target); err != nil {
601: 		return fmt.Errorf("invalid JSON request: %w", err)
602: 	}
603: 	var extra any
604: 	if err := decoder.Decode(&extra); !errors.Is(err, io.EOF) {
605: 		return fmt.Errorf("request must contain one JSON value")
606: 	}
607: 	return nil
608: }

610: func mapOperationRequest(spec operationSpecRequest) (app.OperationRequest, error) {
611: 	if !validOptionalIdentifier(spec.Scope.Project) || !validOptionalIdentifier(spec.Scope.Sprint) || !validOptionalIdentifier(spec.Scope.Study) {
612: 		return app.OperationRequest{}, fmt.Errorf("operation scope contains an invalid identifier")
613: 	}
614: 	options := spec.Options
615: 	req := app.OperationRequest{
616: 		Project: spec.Scope.Project, Sprint: spec.Scope.Sprint, Study: spec.Scope.Study,
617: 		Stage: firstString(options.ToStage, options.Stage), Task: options.Task, Model: options.Model,
618: 		Level: options.Level, Suite: options.Suite, Test: options.Test, Timeout: options.Timeout,
619: 		ForceReview: options.ForceReview, RestartReview: options.RestartReview, OverrideRationale: options.OverrideRationale,
620: 		ReviewFocus: options.ReviewFocus, Sources: options.Sources, Dimensions: options.Dimensions, Parallelism: options.Parallelism,
621: 	}
622: 	kind := strings.ReplaceAll(strings.TrimSpace(spec.Kind), "_", "-")
623: 	switch kind {
624: 	case "validation", "validate":
625: 		req.Kind = app.OperationValidate
626: 	case "sprint-status":
627: 		req.Kind = app.OperationSprintStatus
628: 	case "prompt-preview", "sprint-prompt":
629: 		req.Kind = app.OperationPrompt
630: 	case "dry-run", "sprint-flow-dry-run":
631: 		req.Kind = app.OperationFlowDryRun
632: 	case "sprint-flow":
633: 		if options.DryRun {
634: 			req.Kind = app.OperationFlowDryRun
635: 		} else {
636: 			req.Kind = app.OperationFlow
637: 		}
638: 	case "sprint-stage":
639: 		if options.DryRun {
640: 			req.Kind = app.OperationStageDryRun
641: 		} else {
642: 			req.Kind = app.OperationStage
643: 		}
644: 	case "sprint-stage-dry-run":
645: 		req.Kind = app.OperationStageDryRun
646: 	case "execute", "execute-start":
647: 		switch {
648: 		case options.Action == "status":
649: 			req.Kind = app.OperationExecuteStatus
650: 		case options.DryRun:
651: 			req.Kind = app.OperationExecuteDryRun
652: 		case options.Resume:
653: 			req.Kind = app.OperationExecuteResume
654: 		default:
655: 			req.Kind = app.OperationExecuteStart
656: 		}
657: 	case "execute-status":
658: 		req.Kind = app.OperationExecuteStatus
659: 	case "execute-dry-run":
660: 		req.Kind = app.OperationExecuteDryRun
661: 	case "execute-resume":
662: 		req.Kind = app.OperationExecuteResume
663: 	case "review", "review-start":
664: 		if options.Action == "status" {
665: 			req.Kind = app.OperationReviewStatus
666: 		} else if options.DryRun {
667: 			req.Kind = app.OperationReviewDryRun
668: 		} else {
669: 			req.Kind = app.OperationReviewStart
670: 		}
671: 	case "review-status":
672: 		req.Kind = app.OperationReviewStatus
673: 	case "review-dry-run":
674: 		req.Kind = app.OperationReviewDryRun
675: 	case "smoke", "smoke-start":
676: 		if options.Action == "status" {
677: 			req.Kind = app.OperationSmokeStatus
678: 		} else if options.DryRun {
679: 			req.Kind = app.OperationSmokeDryRun
680: 		} else {
681: 			req.Kind = app.OperationSmokeStart
682: 		}
683: 	case "smoke-status":
684: 		req.Kind = app.OperationSmokeStatus
685: 	case "smoke-dry-run":
686: 		req.Kind = app.OperationSmokeDryRun
687: 	case "verify", "verify-start":
688: 		if options.DryRun {
689: 			req.Kind = app.OperationVerifyDryRun
690: 		} else {
691: 			req.Kind = app.OperationVerifyStart
692: 		}
693: 	case "verify-dry-run":
694: 		req.Kind = app.OperationVerifyDryRun
695: 	case "qa-status":
696: 		req.Kind = app.OperationQAStatus
697: 	case "qa-dry-run":
698: 		req.Kind = app.OperationQADryRun
699: 	case "qa-start":
700: 		req.Kind = app.OperationQAStart
701: 		req.Task = options.Shard
702: 	case "qa-resume":
703: 		req.Kind = app.OperationQAResume
704: 		req.Task = options.Shard
705: 	case "qa-recover":
706: 		req.Kind = app.OperationQARecover
707: 	case "study-run-loop", "study-start":
708: 		if options.Resume {
709: 			req.Kind = app.OperationStudyResume
710: 		} else {
711: 			req.Kind = app.OperationStudyStart
712: 		}
713: 	case "study-resume":
714: 		req.Kind = app.OperationStudyResume
715: 	case "study-cancel":
716: 		req.Kind = app.OperationStudyCancel
717: 	default:
718: 		return app.OperationRequest{}, fmt.Errorf("unsupported operation kind %q", spec.Kind)
719: 	}
720: 	if req.Kind == app.OperationValidate {
721: 		if (req.Project == "") == (req.Study == "") {
722: 			return app.OperationRequest{}, fmt.Errorf("validation requires one project or study scope")
723: 		}
724: 	} else if strings.HasPrefix(string(req.Kind), "study-") {
725: 		if req.Study == "" || req.Project != "" || req.Sprint != "" {
726: 			return app.OperationRequest{}, fmt.Errorf("study operations require only scope.study")
727: 		}
728: 	} else if req.Project == "" {
729: 		return app.OperationRequest{}, fmt.Errorf("project operations require scope.project")
730: 	} else if req.Sprint == "" {
731: 		return app.OperationRequest{}, fmt.Errorf("sprint operations require scope.sprint")
732: 	}
733: 	if strings.HasPrefix(string(req.Kind), "qa-") {
734: 		if options.Task != "" || options.Model != "" || options.Stage != "" || options.ToStage != "" || options.Action != "" || options.DryRun || options.Resume || options.Level != "" || options.Suite != "" || options.Test != "" || options.Timeout != "" || options.ForceReview || options.RestartReview || options.OverrideRationale != "" || len(options.ReviewFocus) > 0 || len(options.Sources) > 0 || len(options.Dimensions) > 0 || options.Parallelism != 0 {
735: 			return app.OperationRequest{}, fmt.Errorf("QA operations accept only options.shard")
736: 		}
737: 		if options.Shard != "" && req.Kind != app.OperationQAStart && req.Kind != app.OperationQAResume {
738: 			return app.OperationRequest{}, fmt.Errorf("QA shard is valid only for start or resume")
739: 		}
740: 	}
741: 	return req, nil
742: }

749: 	if req.Sprint != "" {

788: func (h *handler) writeOperationError(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request, err error) {
789: 	status, code, message, retryable := http.StatusBadRequest, "invalid_request", "The operation request is invalid.", false
790: 	details := map[string]any{}
791: 	switch {
792: 	case errors.Is(err, errConfirmationExpired):
793: 		status, code, message, retryable = http.StatusConflict, "confirmation_expired", "The confirmation expired. Prepare the operation again.", true
794: 	case errors.Is(err, errConfirmationMismatch):
795: 		status, code, message = http.StatusConflict, "confirmation_mismatch", "The confirmation does not match this session or operation."
796: 	case errors.Is(err, errConfirmationReplayed):
797: 		status, code, message = http.StatusConflict, "confirmation_replayed", "The confirmation was already used or is unknown."
798: 	case errors.Is(err, errStaleConfirmation), errors.Is(err, app.ErrStaleOperation):
799: 		status, code, message, retryable = http.StatusConflict, "stale_confirmation", "The operation inputs changed after confirmation. Prepare it again.", true
800: 	case errors.Is(err, errOperationNotFound):
801: 		status, code, message = http.StatusNotFound, "operation_not_found", "The operation is no longer retained. Refresh durable status."
802: 		details["action"] = "refresh_durable_status"
803: 	case errors.Is(err, errOperationCapacity):
804: 		status, code, message, retryable = http.StatusTooManyRequests, "operation_capacity", "Operation capacity is currently full.", true
805: 		w.Header().Set("Retry-After", "2")
806: 	case errors.Is(err, errSubscriberCapacity):
807: 		status, code, message, retryable = http.StatusTooManyRequests, "subscriber_capacity", "Stream capacity is currently full.", true
808: 		w.Header().Set("Retry-After", "2")
809: 	case errors.Is(err, errServerDraining):
810: 		status, code, message, retryable = http.StatusServiceUnavailable, "server_draining", "The server is shutting down and is not accepting new work.", true
811: 		w.Header().Set("Retry-After", "2")
812: 	case errors.Is(err, context.Canceled), errors.Is(err, context.DeadlineExceeded):
813: 		status, code, message, retryable = http.StatusServiceUnavailable, "server_draining", "The server is shutting down.", true
814: 	case strings.Contains(strings.ToLower(err.Error()), "validation"), strings.Contains(strings.ToLower(err.Error()), "incomplete"), strings.Contains(strings.ToLower(err.Error()), "prerequisite"):
815: 		status, code, message = http.StatusUnprocessableEntity, "validation_failed", "The governed inputs failed validation."

447: func (h *handler) followDurableOperationEvents(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request, id string, after uint64) bool {
448: 	if h.runs == nil {
449: 		return false
450: 	}
451: 	snapshot, err := h.runs.Run(r.Context(), app.RunID(id))
452: 	if err != nil || string(snapshot.RunID) != id || snapshot.Target.Kind != "operation" {
453: 		return false
454: 	}
455: 	if after > snapshot.LastSequence {
456: 		h.writeError(w, r, http.StatusConflict, "cursor_ahead", "The event cursor is ahead of the durable operation.")
457: 		return true
458: 	}
459: 	if after+1 < snapshot.OldestRetainedSequence {
460: 		h.writeError(w, r, http.StatusConflict, "replay_gap", "The requested operation history is no longer retained; refresh its canonical run.")
461: 		return true
462: 	}
463: 	flusher, ok := w.(http.Flusher)
464: 	if !ok {
465: 		h.writeOperationError(w, r, errors.New("streaming unavailable"))
466: 		return true
467: 	}
468: 	w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "text/event-stream; charset=utf-8")
469: 	w.Header().Set("Connection", "keep-alive")
470: 	w.Header().Set("X-Accel-Buffering", "no")
471: 	w.WriteHeader(http.StatusOK)
472: 	flusher.Flush()
473: 	heartbeat := time.NewTicker(SSEHeartbeat)
474: 	defer heartbeat.Stop()
475: 	lifetime := time.NewTimer(MaxStreamLifetime)
476: 	defer lifetime.Stop()
477: 	poll := time.NewTimer(0)
478: 	defer poll.Stop()
479: 	for {
480: 		select {
481: 		case <-poll.C:
482: 			events, eventErr := h.runs.RunEvents(r.Context(), snapshot.RunID, after, 512)
483: 			if eventErr != nil {
484: 				return true
485: 			}
486: 			for _, event := range events {
487: 				projected := durableOperationEvent(event)
488: 				if err := writeSSEEvent(w, projected); err != nil {
489: 					return true
490: 				}
491: 				after = event.Sequence
492: 			}
493: 			flusher.Flush()
494: 			snapshot, eventErr = h.runs.Run(r.Context(), snapshot.RunID)
495: 			if eventErr != nil || snapshot.Lifecycle.IsTerminal() && after >= snapshot.LastSequence {
496: 				return true
497: 			}
498: 			wait := time.Second
499: 			if len(events) == 512 || after < snapshot.LastSequence {
500: 				wait = 250 * time.Millisecond
501: 			}
502: 			poll.Reset(wait)
503: 		case <-heartbeat.C:
504: 			if _, err := io.WriteString(w, ": heartbeat\n\n"); err != nil {
505: 				return true
506: 			}
507: 			flusher.Flush()
508: 		case <-lifetime.C:
509: 			return true
510: 		case <-r.Context().Done():
511: 			return true
512: 		}
513: 	}
514: }

154: func preparePrivateDatabase(root string) (string, error) {
155: 	directory := filepath.Join(root, ".ultraplan")
156: 	info, err := os.Lstat(directory)
157: 	switch {
158: 	case errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist):
159: 		if err := os.Mkdir(directory, 0o700); err != nil {
160: 			return "", classifyStoreError("create_directory", "create private run-control directory failed", err)
161: 		}
162: 	case err != nil:
163: 		return "", classifyStoreError("inspect_directory", "inspect run-control directory failed", err)
164: 	case info.Mode()&os.ModeSymlink != 0 || !info.IsDir():
165: 		return "", invalidField("run_control_directory", "must be a real directory, not a symlink")
166: 	}
167: 	if err := enforcePrivateMode(directory, 0o700); err != nil {
168: 		return "", err
169: 	}
170: 
171: 	path := filepath.Join(directory, "run-control.db")
172: 	info, err = os.Lstat(path)
173: 	switch {
174: 	case errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist):
175: 		file, createErr := os.OpenFile(path, os.O_CREATE|os.O_EXCL|os.O_RDWR, 0o600)
176: 		if createErr != nil {
177: 			return "", classifyStoreError("create_database", "create private run-control database failed", createErr)
178: 		}
179: 		if closeErr := file.Close(); closeErr != nil {
180: 			return "", classifyStoreError("close_database", "close new run-control database failed", closeErr)
181: 		}
182: 	case err != nil:

194: 	if err := os.Chmod(path, want); err != nil {

198: 	if err != nil {

201: 	if got := info.Mode().Perm(); got != want {
202: 		return wrapError(CodePermission, "verify_permissions", fmt.Sprintf("private permissions are %04o; require %04o", got, want), false, nil)
203: 	}
204: 	return nil

381: 	if ctx == nil {
382: 		ctx = context.Background()
383: 	}
384: 	if usage, err := r.storageBytes(); err != nil {
385: 		return Snapshot{}, err
386: 	} else if usage >= r.retention.HardQuotaBytes*80/100 {
387: 		if _, compactErr := r.Compact(ctx, 64); compactErr != nil {
388: 			return Snapshot{}, compactErr
389: 		}
390: 	}
391: 	if usage, err := r.storageBytes(); err != nil {
392: 		return Snapshot{}, err
393: 	} else if usage >= r.softQuota {
394: 		return Snapshot{}, wrapError(CodeQuota, "accept_quota", "run-control soft quota prevents new acceptance", true, nil)

396: 	if err := input.Target.Validate(); err != nil {
397: 		return Snapshot{}, err
398: 	}
399: 	if err := input.Correlation.Validate(); err != nil {
400: 		return Snapshot{}, err

409: 		if err != nil {

415: 	}

418: 		return Snapshot{}, err
419: 	}
420: 	now := r.now()

422: 	if err != nil {
423: 		if ctxErr := ctx.Err(); ctxErr != nil {
424: 			return Snapshot{}, ctxErr
425: 		}
426: 		return Snapshot{}, classifyStoreError("accept_begin", "begin durable acceptance failed", err)

431:     run_id, target_kind, operation_kind, project_id, sprint_id, study_id, stage_id, task_id,
432:     lifecycle, liveness, record_state, accepted_at, updated_at, correlation_json,
433:     product_status, confirmation_digest, cancellation_state
434: ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)`,

442: 		}
443: 		return Snapshot{}, classifyStoreError("accept", "persist durable acceptance failed", err)
444: 	}

446: 		if len(input.OperationAlias) > MaxSafeValueBytes || strings.ContainsAny(input.OperationAlias, "\x00\r\n") {
447: 			return Snapshot{}, invalidField("operation_alias", "must be a bounded opaque value")
448: 		}
449: 		if _, err := tx.ExecContext(ctx, `INSERT INTO operation_aliases (alias_id, run_id, alias_kind, created_at) VALUES (?, ?, 'operation', ?)`, input.OperationAlias, string(runID), formatTime(now)); err != nil {

462: 	}
463: 	if err := tx.Commit(); err != nil {
464: 		return Snapshot{}, classifyStoreError("accept_commit", "commit durable acceptance failed", err)
465: 	}
466: 	r.log(ctx, LogInfo, "run accepted",
467: 		LogField{Key: "run_id", Value: string(runID)}, LogField{Key: "target_kind", Value: input.Target.Kind},
468: 		LogField{Key: "operation", Value: input.Target.Operation}, LogField{Key: "lifecycle", Value: string(snapshot.Lifecycle)})
469: 	return snapshot, nil
470: }

472: func (r *SQLiteRepository) ResolveOperationAlias(ctx context.Context, alias string) (Snapshot, error) {
473: 	if strings.TrimSpace(alias) == "" || len(alias) > MaxSafeValueBytes || strings.ContainsAny(alias, "\x00\r\n") {
474: 		return Snapshot{}, invalidField("operation_alias", "must be a bounded opaque value")
475: 	}

477: 	if err := r.db.QueryRowContext(ctx, `SELECT run_id FROM operation_aliases WHERE alias_id = ?`, alias).Scan(&runID); err != nil {
478: 		if errors.Is(err, sql.ErrNoRows) {
479: 			return Snapshot{}, wrapError(CodeNotFound, "resolve_alias", "operation alias is not retained", false, err)
480: 		}
481: 		return Snapshot{}, classifyStoreError("resolve_alias", "resolve operation alias failed", err)
482: 	}
483: 	return r.Snapshot(ctx, runID)
484: }

486: func (r *SQLiteRepository) Claim(ctx context.Context, input Claim) (Attempt, Snapshot, error) {
487: 	if ctx == nil {
488: 		ctx = context.Background()
489: 	}
490: 	if err := input.RunID.Validate(); err != nil {
491: 		return Attempt{}, Snapshot{}, err
492: 	}
493: 	if err := input.Owner.Validate(); err != nil {
494: 		return Attempt{}, Snapshot{}, err
495: 	}
496: 	if err := input.Correlation.Validate(); err != nil {
497: 		return Attempt{}, Snapshot{}, err
498: 	}
499: 	if input.Lease <= 0 {
500: 		return Attempt{}, Snapshot{}, invalidField("lease", "must be positive")
501: 	}
502: 	attemptID := input.AttemptID
503: 	var err error
504: 	if attemptID == "" {
505: 		attemptID, err = r.ids.NewAttemptID()
506: 		if err != nil {
507: 			return Attempt{}, Snapshot{}, err
508: 		}
509: 	}
510: 	if err := attemptID.Validate(); err != nil {
511: 		return Attempt{}, Snapshot{}, err
512: 	}
513: 	correlation, err := marshalBounded(input.Correlation, MaxSafeValueBytes*8)
514: 	if err != nil {
515: 		return Attempt{}, Snapshot{}, err
516: 	}
517: 	now := r.now()
518: 	leaseAt := now.Add(input.Lease)
519: 	tx, err := r.db.BeginTx(ctx, nil)
520: 	if err != nil {
521: 		if ctxErr := ctx.Err(); ctxErr != nil {
522: 			return Attempt{}, Snapshot{}, ctxErr
523: 		}
524: 		return Attempt{}, Snapshot{}, classifyStoreError("claim_begin", "begin owner claim failed", err)
525: 	}
526: 	defer tx.Rollback()
527: 	var lifecycle string
528: 	var currentAttempt sql.NullString
529: 	if err := tx.QueryRowContext(ctx, `SELECT lifecycle, current_attempt_id FROM runs WHERE run_id = ?`, string(input.RunID)).Scan(&lifecycle, &currentAttempt); err != nil {
530: 		return Attempt{}, Snapshot{}, mapRunLookupError("claim", input.RunID, err)
531: 	}
532: 	state := Lifecycle(lifecycle)
533: 	if state.IsTerminal() {
534: 		return Attempt{}, Snapshot{}, runError(CodeTerminal, "claim", input.RunID, "terminal run cannot be claimed", false, nil)
535: 	}
536: 	if currentAttempt.Valid && currentAttempt.String != "" {
537: 		return Attempt{}, Snapshot{}, runError(CodeConflict, "claim", input.RunID, "run already has a current owner attempt", false, nil)
538: 	}
539: 	nextLifecycle := LifecycleRunning
540: 	if state == LifecycleCancelling {
541: 		nextLifecycle = LifecycleCancelling
542: 	}
543: 	var ordinal, generation uint64
544: 	if err := tx.QueryRowContext(ctx, `SELECT COALESCE(MAX(ordinal), 0) + 1, COALESCE(MAX(fencing_generation), 0) + 1 FROM attempts WHERE run_id = ?`, string(input.RunID)).Scan(&ordinal, &generation); err != nil {
545: 		return Attempt{}, Snapshot{}, classifyStoreError("claim_allocate", "allocate owner fence failed", err)
546: 	}
547: 	_, err = tx.ExecContext(ctx, `
548: INSERT INTO attempts (
549:     attempt_id, run_id, ordinal, owner_id, fencing_generation, host_digest, boot_id, pid,
550:     process_birth_token, claimed_at, heartbeat_at, lease_expires_at, correlation_json
551: ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)`,
552: 		string(attemptID), string(input.RunID), ordinal, input.Owner.ID, generation,
553: 		input.Owner.Process.HostDigest, input.Owner.Process.BootID, input.Owner.Process.PID,
554: 		input.Owner.Process.BirthToken, formatTime(now), formatTime(now), formatTime(leaseAt), correlation)
555: 	if err != nil {
556: 		if isConstraint(err) {
557: 			return Attempt{}, Snapshot{}, runError(CodeConflict, "claim", input.RunID, "attempt identity or fence already exists", false, err)
558: 		}
559: 		return Attempt{}, Snapshot{}, classifyStoreError("claim", "persist owner claim failed", err)
560: 	}
561: 	result, err := tx.ExecContext(ctx, `
562: UPDATE runs
563: SET current_attempt_id = ?, lifecycle = ?, liveness = ?, started_at = COALESCE(started_at, ?), updated_at = ?
564: WHERE run_id = ? AND current_attempt_id IS NULL AND terminal_outcome IS NULL`,
565: 		string(attemptID), string(nextLifecycle), string(LivenessLive), formatTime(now), formatTime(now), string(input.RunID))
566: 	if err != nil {
567: 		return Attempt{}, Snapshot{}, classifyStoreError("claim_snapshot", "update run owner snapshot failed", err)
568: 	}
569: 	if changed, err := result.RowsAffected(); err != nil || changed != 1 {
570: 		return Attempt{}, Snapshot{}, runError(CodeConflict, "claim", input.RunID, "run owner changed while claiming", true, err)
571: 	}
572: 	snapshot, err := loadSnapshot(ctx, tx, input.RunID)
573: 	if err != nil {
574: 		return Attempt{}, Snapshot{}, err
575: 	}
576: 	if err := snapshot.Validate(); err != nil {
577: 		return Attempt{}, Snapshot{}, err
578: 	}
579: 	if err := tx.Commit(); err != nil {
580: 		return Attempt{}, Snapshot{}, classifyStoreError("claim_commit", "commit owner claim failed", err)
581: 	}
582: 	attempt := Attempt{
583: 		ID: attemptID, RunID: input.RunID, Ordinal: ordinal, Owner: input.Owner,
584: 		FencingGeneration: generation, ClaimedAt: now, HeartbeatAt: now,
585: 		LeaseExpiresAt: leaseAt, Correlation: input.Correlation,
586: 	}
587: 	r.log(ctx, LogInfo, "run owner claimed",
588: 		LogField{Key: "run_id", Value: string(input.RunID)}, LogField{Key: "attempt_id", Value: string(attemptID)},
589: 		LogField{Key: "owner_id", Value: input.Owner.ID}, LogField{Key: "fencing_generation", Value: strconv.FormatUint(generation, 10)},
590: 		LogField{Key: "lifecycle", Value: string(snapshot.Lifecycle)})
591: 	return attempt, snapshot, nil
592: }

608: func (r *SQLiteRepository) Append(ctx context.Context, fence Fence, draft EventDraft) (eventResult Event, snapshotResult Snapshot, resultErr error) {
609: 	metricStarted := time.Now()
610: 	defer func() { r.metrics.append.observe(metricStarted, resultErr) }()
611: 	if ctx == nil {
612: 		ctx = context.Background()
613: 	}
614: 	if err := fence.Validate(); err != nil {
615: 		return Event{}, Snapshot{}, err
616: 	}
617: 	draft = sanitizeEventDraft(NormalizeEventDraft(draft))
618: 	if usage, err := r.storageBytes(); err != nil {
619: 		return Event{}, Snapshot{}, err
620: 	} else if usage >= r.retention.HardQuotaBytes && !reservedEventType(draft.Type) {
621: 		return Event{}, Snapshot{}, runError(CodeQuota, "append_quota", fence.RunID, "hard quota permits only reserved lifecycle recovery writes", true, nil)
622: 	}
623: 	if err := validateEventDraft(draft); err != nil {
624: 		return Event{}, Snapshot{}, err
625: 	}
626: 	payload, err := marshalBounded(draft.Payload, MaxSafeValueBytes*8)
627: 	if err != nil {
628: 		return Event{}, Snapshot{}, err
629: 	}
630: 	var omissionJSON any
631: 	if draft.Omission != nil {
632: 		encoded, err := marshalBounded(draft.Omission, MaxSafeValueBytes*2)
633: 		if err != nil {
634: 			return Event{}, Snapshot{}, err
635: 		}
636: 		omissionJSON = encoded
637: 	}
638: 	now := r.now()
639: 	tx, err := r.db.BeginTx(ctx, nil)
640: 	if err != nil {
641: 		if ctxErr := ctx.Err(); ctxErr != nil {
642: 			return Event{}, Snapshot{}, ctxErr
643: 		}
644: 		return Event{}, Snapshot{}, classifyStoreError("append_begin", "begin event append failed", err)
645: 	}
646: 	defer tx.Rollback()
647: 	if err := verifyFence(ctx, tx, fence); err != nil {
648: 		return Event{}, Snapshot{}, err
649: 	}
650: 	var lastSequence uint64
651: 	var lifecycle string
652: 	if err := tx.QueryRowContext(ctx, `SELECT last_sequence, lifecycle FROM runs WHERE run_id = ?`, string(fence.RunID)).Scan(&lastSequence, &lifecycle); err != nil {
653: 		return Event{}, Snapshot{}, mapRunLookupError("append", fence.RunID, err)
654: 	}
655: 	current := Lifecycle(lifecycle)
656: 	if current.IsTerminal() {
657: 		return Event{}, Snapshot{}, runError(CodeTerminal, "append", fence.RunID, "terminal run journal is immutable", false, nil)
658: 	}
659: 	nextLifecycle := current
660: 	if draft.Lifecycle != "" {
661: 		if !validActiveTransition(current, draft.Lifecycle) {
662: 			return Event{}, Snapshot{}, runError(CodeInvariant, "append", fence.RunID, fmt.Sprintf("invalid lifecycle transition %s -> %s", current, draft.Lifecycle), false, nil)
663: 		}
664: 		nextLifecycle = draft.Lifecycle
665: 	}
666: 	sequence := lastSequence + 1
667: 	if _, err := tx.ExecContext(ctx, `
668: INSERT INTO events (run_id, sequence, committed_at, event_type, attempt_id, stage_id, task_id, payload_json, omission_json)
669: VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)`, string(fence.RunID), sequence, formatTime(now), string(draft.Type),
670: 		string(fence.AttemptID), draft.Stage, draft.Task, payload, omissionJSON); err != nil {
671: 		return Event{}, Snapshot{}, classifyStoreError("append_event", "persist ordered event failed", err)
672: 	}
673: 	omissionCount := uint64(0)
674: 	if draft.Omission != nil {
675: 		omissionCount = draft.Omission.Count
676: 	}
677: 	result, err := tx.ExecContext(ctx, `
678: UPDATE runs SET last_sequence = ?, lifecycle = ?, omission_total = omission_total + ?, updated_at = ?
679: WHERE run_id = ? AND last_sequence = ? AND current_attempt_id = ? AND terminal_outcome IS NULL`,
680: 		sequence, string(nextLifecycle), omissionCount, formatTime(now), string(fence.RunID), lastSequence, string(fence.AttemptID))
681: 	if err != nil {
682: 		return Event{}, Snapshot{}, classifyStoreError("append_snapshot", "update durable event snapshot failed", err)
683: 	}
684: 	if changed, err := result.RowsAffected(); err != nil || changed != 1 {
685: 		return Event{}, Snapshot{}, runError(CodeStaleFence, "append", fence.RunID, "event writer lost its authoritative fence", false, err)
686: 	}
687: 	if err := compactRunJournal(ctx, tx, fence.RunID, sequence); err != nil {
688: 		return Event{}, Snapshot{}, err
689: 	}
690: 	snapshot, err := loadSnapshot(ctx, tx, fence.RunID)
691: 	if err != nil {
692: 		return Event{}, Snapshot{}, err
693: 	}
694: 	if err := snapshot.Validate(); err != nil {
695: 		return Event{}, Snapshot{}, err
696: 	}
697: 	if err := tx.Commit(); err != nil {
698: 		return Event{}, Snapshot{}, classifyStoreError("append_commit", "commit ordered event failed", err)
699: 	}
700: 	event := Event{
701: 		RunID: fence.RunID, Sequence: sequence, CommittedAt: now, Type: draft.Type,
702: 		AttemptID: fence.AttemptID, Stage: draft.Stage, Task: draft.Task,
703: 		Payload: clonePayload(draft.Payload), Omission: cloneOmission(draft.Omission),
704: 	}
705: 	r.notify(fence.RunID, sequence)
706: 	r.log(ctx, LogDebug, "run event committed",
707: 		LogField{Key: "run_id", Value: string(fence.RunID)}, LogField{Key: "attempt_id", Value: string(fence.AttemptID)},
708: 		LogField{Key: "sequence", Value: strconv.FormatUint(sequence, 10)}, LogField{Key: "event_type", Value: string(draft.Type)},
709: 		LogField{Key: "lifecycle", Value: string(snapshot.Lifecycle)})
710: 	return event, snapshot, nil
711: }

713: func reservedEventType(eventType EventType) bool {
714: 	switch eventType {
715: 	case EventLifecycle, EventWarning, EventCancellation, EventRecovery, EventTerminal, EventOmission:
716: 		return true
717: 	default:
718: 		return false
719: 	}
720: }

722: func (r *SQLiteRepository) ProposeTerminal(ctx context.Context, fence Fence, proposal TerminalProposal) (snapshotResult Snapshot, wonResult bool, resultErr error) {
723: 	metricStarted := time.Now()
724: 	defer func() { r.metrics.terminal.observe(metricStarted, resultErr) }()
725: 	if ctx == nil {
726: 		ctx = context.Background()
727: 	}
728: 	if err := fence.Validate(); err != nil {
729: 		return Snapshot{}, false, err
730: 	}
731: 	if !proposal.Outcome.IsValid() {
732: 		return Snapshot{}, false, invalidField("terminal.outcome", "is unknown")
733: 	}
734: 	if len(proposal.Reason) > MaxSafeValueBytes || len(proposal.ProposedBy) > MaxSafeValueBytes {
735: 		return Snapshot{}, false, invalidField("terminal", "contains an unbounded reason or proposer")
736: 	}
737: 	now := r.now()
738: 	tx, err := r.db.BeginTx(ctx, nil)
739: 	if err != nil {
740: 		if ctxErr := ctx.Err(); ctxErr != nil {
741: 			return Snapshot{}, false, ctxErr
742: 		}
743: 		return Snapshot{}, false, classifyStoreError("terminal_begin", "begin terminal proposal failed", err)
744: 	}
745: 	defer tx.Rollback()
746: 	if err := verifyFence(ctx, tx, fence); err != nil {
747: 		return Snapshot{}, false, err
748: 	}
749: 	current, err := loadSnapshot(ctx, tx, fence.RunID)
750: 	if err != nil {
751: 		return Snapshot{}, false, err
752: 	}
753: 	if current.Terminal != nil {
754: 		if err := tx.Commit(); err != nil {
755: 			return Snapshot{}, false, classifyStoreError("terminal_read_commit", "finish terminal winner read failed", err)
756: 		}
757: 		return current, false, nil
758: 	}
759: 	sequence := current.LastSequence + 1
760: 	payload, err := marshalBounded(map[string]string{"outcome": string(proposal.Outcome), "reason": proposal.Reason}, MaxSafeValueBytes*2)
761: 	if err != nil {
762: 		return Snapshot{}, false, err
763: 	}
764: 	if _, err := tx.ExecContext(ctx, `
765: INSERT INTO events (run_id, sequence, committed_at, event_type, attempt_id, payload_json)
766: VALUES (?, ?, ?, 'terminal', ?, ?)`, string(fence.RunID), sequence, formatTime(now), string(fence.AttemptID), payload); err != nil {
767: 		return Snapshot{}, false, classifyStoreError("terminal_event", "persist terminal event failed", err)
768: 	}
769: 	result, err := tx.ExecContext(ctx, `
770: UPDATE runs
771: SET lifecycle = ?, liveness = ?, finished_at = ?, updated_at = ?, last_sequence = ?,
772:     terminal_outcome = ?, terminal_reason = ?, terminal_at = ?, terminal_proposed_by = ?
773: WHERE run_id = ? AND current_attempt_id = ? AND terminal_outcome IS NULL`,
774: 		string(proposal.Outcome.Lifecycle()), string(LivenessTerminal), formatTime(now), formatTime(now), sequence,
775: 		string(proposal.Outcome), proposal.Reason, formatTime(now), proposal.ProposedBy,
776: 		string(fence.RunID), string(fence.AttemptID))
777: 	if err != nil {
778: 		return Snapshot{}, false, classifyStoreError("terminal_cas", "persist terminal winner failed", err)
779: 	}
780: 	changed, err := result.RowsAffected()
781: 	if err != nil {
782: 		return Snapshot{}, false, classifyStoreError("terminal_cas", "inspect terminal winner failed", err)
783: 	}
784: 	if changed != 1 {
785: 		return Snapshot{}, false, runError(CodeStaleFence, "terminal_cas", fence.RunID, "terminal proposer lost its authoritative fence", false, nil)
786: 	}
787: 	if _, err := tx.ExecContext(ctx, `UPDATE attempts SET outcome = ? WHERE attempt_id = ? AND run_id = ? AND owner_id = ? AND fencing_generation = ?`,
788: 		string(proposal.Outcome), string(fence.AttemptID), string(fence.RunID), fence.OwnerID, fence.FencingGeneration); err != nil {
789: 		return Snapshot{}, false, classifyStoreError("terminal_attempt", "persist attempt outcome failed", err)
790: 	}
791: 	winner, err := loadSnapshot(ctx, tx, fence.RunID)
792: 	if err != nil {
793: 		return Snapshot{}, false, err
794: 	}
795: 	if err := winner.Validate(); err != nil {
796: 		return Snapshot{}, false, err
797: 	}
798: 	if err := tx.Commit(); err != nil {
799: 		return Snapshot{}, false, classifyStoreError("terminal_commit", "commit terminal winner failed", err)
800: 	}
801: 	r.notify(fence.RunID, sequence)
802: 	r.log(ctx, LogInfo, "run terminal committed",
803: 		LogField{Key: "run_id", Value: string(fence.RunID)}, LogField{Key: "attempt_id", Value: string(fence.AttemptID)},
804: 		LogField{Key: "sequence", Value: strconv.FormatUint(sequence, 10)}, LogField{Key: "terminal_outcome", Value: string(proposal.Outcome)},
805: 		LogField{Key: "terminal_winner", Value: "true"})
806: 	return winner, true, nil
807: }

809: func (r *SQLiteRepository) Events(ctx context.Context, runID RunID, after uint64, limit int) ([]Event, error) {
810: 	if err := runID.Validate(); err != nil {
811: 		return nil, err
812: 	}
813: 	if limit == 0 {
814: 		limit = defaultEventPage
815: 	}
816: 	if limit < 1 || limit > maxEventPage {
817: 		return nil, invalidField("event_limit", fmt.Sprintf("must be between 1 and %d", maxEventPage))
818: 	}
819: 	rows, err := r.db.QueryContext(ctx, `
820: SELECT sequence, committed_at, event_type, attempt_id, stage_id, task_id, payload_json, omission_json
821: FROM events WHERE run_id = ? AND sequence > ? ORDER BY sequence ASC LIMIT ?`, string(runID), after, limit)
822: 	if err != nil {
823: 		return nil, classifyStoreError("events", "read retained events failed", err)
824: 	}
825: 	defer rows.Close()
826: 	events := make([]Event, 0, limit)
827: 	for rows.Next() {
828: 		var sequence uint64
829: 		var committed, eventType, stage, task, payload string
830: 		var attempt, omission sql.NullString
831: 		if err := rows.Scan(&sequence, &committed, &eventType, &attempt, &stage, &task, &payload, &omission); err != nil {
832: 			return nil, classifyStoreError("events_scan", "decode retained event failed", err)
833: 		}
834: 		committedAt, err := parseTime(committed)
835: 		if err != nil {
836: 			return nil, err
837: 		}
838: 		event := Event{RunID: runID, Sequence: sequence, CommittedAt: committedAt, Type: EventType(eventType), AttemptID: AttemptID(attempt.String), Stage: stage, Task: task}
839: 		if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(payload), &event.Payload); err != nil {
840: 			return nil, wrapError(CodeCorrupt, "events_decode", "stored event payload is malformed", false, err)
841: 		}
842: 		if omission.Valid {
843: 			event.Omission = &Omission{}
844: 			if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(omission.String), event.Omission); err != nil {
845: 				return nil, wrapError(CodeCorrupt, "events_decode", "stored omission metadata is malformed", false, err)
846: 			}
847: 		}
848: 		events = append(events, event)
849: 	}
850: 	if err := rows.Err(); err != nil {
851: 		return nil, classifyStoreError("events_rows", "read retained events failed", err)
852: 	}
853: 	return events, nil
854: }

856: func (r *SQLiteRepository) Health(ctx context.Context) (Health, error) {
857: 	health := Health{Status: HealthOK, DatabasePath: DatabaseRelativePath, BusyTimeout: BusyTimeout, SoftQuotaBytes: r.softQuota, HardQuotaBytes: r.retention.HardQuotaBytes, ReservedHeadroomBytes: ReservedHeadroomBytes}
858: 	health.Metrics = r.metrics.snapshot()
859: 	if err := r.db.QueryRowContext(ctx, "PRAGMA journal_mode").Scan(&health.JournalMode); err != nil {
860: 		return Health{}, classifyStoreError("health", "read journal mode failed", err)
861: 	}
862: 	var synchronous, foreignKeys int
863: 	if err := r.db.QueryRowContext(ctx, "PRAGMA synchronous").Scan(&synchronous); err != nil {
864: 		return Health{}, classifyStoreError("health", "read synchronous mode failed", err)
865: 	}
866: 	health.Synchronous = strconv.Itoa(synchronous)
867: 	if err := r.db.QueryRowContext(ctx, "PRAGMA foreign_keys").Scan(&foreignKeys); err != nil {
868: 		return Health{}, classifyStoreError("health", "read foreign-key policy failed", err)
869: 	}
870: 	health.ForeignKeys = foreignKeys == 1
871: 	if err := r.db.QueryRowContext(ctx, `SELECT COUNT(*) FROM runs WHERE lifecycle IN ('accepted','queued','running','cancelling')`).Scan(&health.ActiveRuns); err != nil {
872: 		return Health{}, classifyStoreError("health", "read active-run projection failed", err)
873: 	}
874: 	if err := r.db.QueryRowContext(ctx, `SELECT COUNT(*) FROM runs WHERE terminal_outcome IS NULL AND liveness = 'stalled'`).Scan(&health.StalledRuns); err != nil {
875: 		return Health{}, classifyStoreError("health", "read stalled-run projection failed", err)
876: 	}
877: 	if err := r.db.QueryRowContext(ctx, `SELECT COUNT(*) FROM runs WHERE cancellation_state = 'uncertain'`).Scan(&health.CancellationUncertain); err != nil {
878: 		return Health{}, classifyStoreError("health", "read cancellation-uncertainty projection failed", err)
879: 	}
880: 	acceptedPredicate, acceptedArgs := r.expiredTimestampPredicate("runs.accepted_at", ReconciliationGrace)
881: 	leasePredicate, leaseArgs := r.expiredLeasePredicate(ReconciliationGrace)
882: 	backlogArgs := append(acceptedArgs, leaseArgs...)
883: 	backlogWhere := `runs.terminal_outcome IS NULL AND ((runs.current_attempt_id IS NULL AND ` + acceptedPredicate + `)
884: OR (runs.current_attempt_id IS NOT NULL AND ` + leasePredicate + `))`
885: 	if err := r.db.QueryRowContext(ctx, `SELECT COUNT(*) FROM runs LEFT JOIN attempts ON attempts.attempt_id = runs.current_attempt_id
886: WHERE `+backlogWhere, backlogArgs...).Scan(&health.ReconciliationBacklog); err != nil {
887: 		return Health{}, classifyStoreError("health", "read reconciliation backlog failed", err)
888: 	}
889: 	var oldestLease sql.NullString
890: 	if err := r.db.QueryRowContext(ctx, `SELECT MIN(CASE WHEN runs.current_attempt_id IS NULL THEN runs.accepted_at ELSE attempts.lease_expires_at END)
891: FROM runs LEFT JOIN attempts ON attempts.attempt_id = runs.current_attempt_id WHERE `+backlogWhere, backlogArgs...).Scan(&oldestLease); err != nil {
892: 		return Health{}, classifyStoreError("health", "read reconciliation backlog age failed", err)
893: 	}
894: 	if oldestLease.Valid {

249:     updated_at TEXT NOT NULL,
250:     started_at TEXT,
251:     finished_at TEXT,
252:     current_attempt_id TEXT,

344: func createInitialSchema(ctx context.Context, db *sql.DB, migratedAt time.Time) error {
345: 	tx, err := db.BeginTx(ctx, nil)
346: 	if err != nil {
347: 		if ctxErr := ctx.Err(); ctxErr != nil {
348: 			return ctxErr
349: 		}
350: 		return classifyStoreError("begin_schema", "begin run-control schema transaction failed", err)
351: 	}
352: 	defer tx.Rollback()
353: 	if _, err := tx.ExecContext(ctx, initialSchema); err != nil {
354: 		return classifyStoreError("create_schema", "create run-control schema failed", err)
355: 	}
356: 	if _, err := tx.ExecContext(ctx, `INSERT OR REPLACE INTO app_schema (component, version, migrated_at) VALUES ('run_control', 1, ?)`, formatTime(migratedAt)); err != nil {
357: 		return classifyStoreError("record_schema", "record run-control schema version failed", err)
358: 	}
359: 	if _, err := tx.ExecContext(ctx, `PRAGMA user_version = 1`); err != nil {
360: 		return classifyStoreError("record_user_version", "record SQLite user version failed", err)
361: 	}
362: 	if err := tx.Commit(); err != nil {
363: 		return classifyStoreError("commit_schema", "commit run-control schema failed", err)
364: 	}
365: 	return nil
366: }
